findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_character, generate_sprite_motion, generate_sprite_replacement, generate_direction_sprites, generate_direction_animation, generate_npcs, generate_map, generate_tileset, generate_props, extract_scene_assets, generate_music, generate_sound_effects, get_download_url · Private data: generate_character, generate_sprite_motion, generate_sprite_replacement, generate_direction_sprites, generate_direction_animation, generate_npcs, generate_map, generate_tileset, generate_props, extract_scene_assets, generate_music, generate_sound_effects, upload_image, create_upload_url, search_assets, list_characters, get_download_url · Public sink: upload_image, create_upload_url, confirm_upload · Destructive: list_projects.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_character, generate_sprite_motion, generate_sprite_replacement, generate_direction_sprites, generate_direction_animation, generate_npcs, generate_map, generate_tileset, generate_props, extract_scene_assets, generate_music, generate_sound_effects, get_download_url · Private data: generate_character, generate_sprite_motion, generate_sprite_replacement, generate_direction_sprites, generate_direction_animation, generate_npcs, generate_map, generate_tileset, generate_props, extract_scene_assets, generate_music, generate_sound_effects, upload_image, create_upload_url, search_assets, list_characters, get_download_url · Public sink: upload_image, create_upload_url, confirm_upload · Destructive: list_projects

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
